excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]所在的残骸场在某种未知力量的影响下翻滚。
excerpt.en: The debris field which [Root.GetName] is part of roils and swirls under the influence of unknown forces.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]所在的残骸场在某种未知力量的影响下翻滚。
sections.en: The debris field which [Root.GetName] is part of roils and swirls under the influence of unknown forces.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]本应前往[From.From.From.GetName]研究其附近的异常状况，但途中却遭遇了不测。包括科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]及船员在内的整艘舰船在调查太空废墟时突然消失不见了。

而在数分钟后，舰船又重新出现。

据[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报，他们在一瞬之间到达了某个超维度空间。他们从外部观察口看到其附近布满了各式各样的外星舰船，都一动不动地被困在无限的虚空之中。在船员能够判定所在位置之前，船外的景色突然消失，而舰船又重新回到了普通空间之中。

但不幸的是，船上的一半工作人员都消失了——科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些船员应该是因为某种不可知的机制而永远地被困在那里了。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] never made it all the way to [From.From.From.GetName] to study the anomalies surrounding it. The ship, along with Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and crew, blinked out of existence as it was navigating the debris field.

And then reappeared minutes later.

[Root.GetLeaderName] reports that they found themselves, briefly, in some extra-dimensional space. External viewports revealed that they were surrounded by countless ships of alien design, suspended in a seemingly endless void. Before the crew could get their bearings, the vision abruptly faded and they found themselves back in regular space.

However, roughly half of the crew are missing - Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that they may have been selectively trapped, by some unknowable mechanism, in that strange space.

texts.zh:
原本被认为迷失在维度裂缝中的[Root.GetName]失踪船员重新出现了。

所有失踪船员都被放置在一艘与我方科技飞船相似的飞船上，漂浮在[Root.GetName]原本遇到维度陷阱的地方。船员们全数声称，并不记得这期间发生了什么事情，只是隐约觉得自己离开了一段时间。

船员们希望能够回到科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]手下工作，并将飞船移交给了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国。
texts.en:
The missing members of the [Root.GetName]'s crew, thought lost to the dimensional rift, have reappeared.

They hailed us from aboard an unknown vessel, not entirely dissimilar to our own science ships, idling close to where the [Root.GetName] originally experienced the dimensional disturbance. They claim to remember nothing of their time outside our dimension, aside from a vague awareness of having been away for some time.

They wish for nothing but to return to service under Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], and intend to surrender their ship to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] authorities.

texts.zh:
原本被认为迷失在维度裂缝中的[Root.GetName]失踪船员重新出现了。

他们从一艘有机舰船上向我们呼叫，这艘船诡异地与我们的科研船相似，但又微妙地……不同。它的移动方式、脉搏完全不遵循任何已知的基因蓝图，仿佛是某种扭曲的外星意识对我们舰船的怪异理解。它静静的在[Root.GetName]第一次遭遇扰动的坐标附近漂浮、等待着。

船员们什么也不记得。只是有一种模糊的缺席感，一种去了别的地方的感觉，比感受到的时间长得多。然而，它们又没有改变，至少他们自己是这么说的。

船员们希望能够回到科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]手下工作，并将他们怪异而沉默飞船毫不犹豫地移交给了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国。但当我们接收到它们的信息时，一种深沉而陌生的共鸣在通信中嗡嗡作响。船虽然静止不动，但感觉好像在倾听。
texts.en:
The missing crew of the [Root.GetName], long presumed lost to the dimensional rift, have inexplicably reappeared.

They hailed us from aboard an unfamiliar organic construct, its form eerily similar to our own science vessels, yet subtly... off. The way it moves, the way it pulses, it follows no known genetic blueprint, as though it were a reflection of our ships seen through a warped, alien mind. It drifted silently near the coordinates where the [Root.GetName] first encountered the disturbance, waiting.

The crew remembers nothing of their time beyond. Only a vague sensation of absence, of having been somewhere else, for far longer than time should allow. And yet, they are unchanged. Or so they claim.

They wish to return to service under Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], and they offer their strange, silent vessel to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] authorities without hesitation. But as we receive their transmission, a deep and unfamiliar resonance hums through the comms. The ship, though still, feels as though it is listening.

label.zh: 为了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人民的安全必须毁灭它。
label.en: The safety of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] people hinges on their destruction.

label.zh: [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人民的安全与否取决于是否毁灭它们。
label.en: The safety of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] hinges on their destruction.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]穿过小行星带前往[From.GetName]的路上时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报飞船经历了几次来势突然的重力变化。因为好奇，[Root.GetLeaderName]派遣了无人机前去勘测原因。

结果，无人机发现了几只老旧的外星重力生成器。因为极性反转，电池又不足，这些重力生成器时常会对着虚空放射出反重力波。但其效果不强，无法造成任何实质性的伤害。我们无法将生成器的效果恢复至其原本具有的强度。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些生成器本来是为小行星带中某颗较大的小行星提供人造重力用的，但因为某种故障，这颗小行星已经四分五裂了。
texts.en:
As the [Root.GetName] passed through the asteroid belt on its way to [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reported that the ship experienced a number of sudden gravitational shifts. Ever curious, [Root.GetLeaderName] dispatched a number of probes to scan the debris field to discern the cause.

It turns out that the culprit is a number of gravity generators of old, alien make. Sputtering on dying energy sources and with their polarities inverted, they occasionally spew reverse-gravity into the void, though not with enough force to cause any serious harm. Not anymore.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] theorizes that the generators once provided artificial gravity for a large asteroid in the belt, but some malfunction eventually tore the rock apart.
